newsitem.title: USA: U.S. stock index futures stick moderately higher.
newsitem.headline: U.S. stock index futures stick moderately higher.

text.p: May 2 - U.S. stock index futures stuck moderately higher near midday. Action had slowed considerably, with brokers waiting to see whether June S&P 500s manage to keep gains, given slow erosion in T-bond futures, S&Ps' upside failure early below 810.00. Some technicians said last few days of gains formed on shaky foundation, could leave market vulnerable on downside. ((DerivativesDesk(312)408-8750/)) E-mail:derivatives@reuters.com
